description:
Activate Tezzeret the Seeker's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Holding priority, activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret the Seeker's ability, targeting Lithoform Engine and Thran Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret the Seeker's ability, untapping Thran Dynamo and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.
